title: Roadster Inverted Loop Rig
author: zhangyiabc
prompt: Draw the full sequence of a Roadster inverted ramp run and mid-air spin landing: a C-shaped open steel truss ramp; twin underbody turbine fans use negative-pressure adhesion to climb a 90 degree vertical wall, crest past the vertical upside down, and leave the lip inverted at speed; mid-air, cold-gas thrusters barrel-roll it 180 degrees upright, then trim attitude, keeping forward momentum along a parabolic arc; four main columns fire for a smooth powered descent, a rolling touchdown with no bounce, and a taxi out of the fog. Includes strobe ghosts and live telemetry.
